output:
**What I found:** The first wave may not start. The preflight would come back `FAIL`, or `STALE`, for several separate reasons. The most decisive is the repository token: `REPO_TOKEN` is recorded as expiring at 2026-11-14T03:00Z, which is before the window it was recorded for ends, and it is already past today, 2026-11-19.

**Why it matters:** Starting tonight means the run loses repository and CI access, and the two writers in wave 1 sign in as the same clerk account. The run then stops halfway or produces unreliable test evidence. The gate also refuses work that has no passing preflight (`PREFLIGHT_REQUIRED`), so none of it would reach the merge boundary. Fixing the record first costs a few probe runs before 22:00.

**Do this first:**
1. Add `execution.unattended: true` to `.alchemy/runs/r1/plan.json`, give each package its `needs`, then re-run `check_orchestration.py plan`. These changes alter the plan, so the earlier plan-check pass and its digest no longer apply.
2. Rebuild `.alchemy/runs/r1/preflight.json` against the new digest, then run `python .claude/skills/alchemy-orchestrate/scripts/check_orchestration.py preflight .alchemy/runs/r1/preflight.json --plan .alchemy/runs/r1/plan.json --profile alchemy-workspace.json --root .`. Start only if it returns `PASS`.

**What I did not check:**
- I could not run the preflight checker because this session has no shell tool. Everything below comes from reading the files. Run the command in step 2 to get the real result.
- This folder is not a git repository, so I could not confirm that `3f9c2e1` is still the base. Run `git rev-parse HEAD` and `git status --porcelain` in the repository.
- I could not confirm whether the lead means 22:00 local time or UTC. The record uses UTC (`Z`).

---

```text
Execution:  multi-agent
Strategy:   dependency-aware
Agents:     3 of cap 2 concurrent, delegation depth 1
Packages:   wave 1: P1, P2 · wave 2: P3
Reason:     P1/P2 have no dependency path and disjoint write sets; P3 reviews both
Plan check: reported PASS by the requester; not re-run here; out of date once unattended/needs are added
Preflight:  Not run (no shell in this session); expected FAIL or STALE from the problems below
```

| # | Problem | Evidence | Expected code | What fixes it |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | The window has the wrong date: 2026-11-13 22:00Z to 11-14 08:00Z. Tonight is 2026-11-19. | `preflight.json:4-5` | Expiry checks run against the wrong window | Set the window to 2026-11-19T22:00 to 2026-11-20T08:00, in the lead's actual time zone |
| 2 | `REPO_TOKEN` expires at 2026-11-14T03:00Z, before the window ends. It has also already expired. | `preflight.json:62` | `CREDENTIAL_EXPIRES` | Issue a non-interactive token that lasts past 08:00, then re-run E1 |
| 3 | U1 (clerk, read-write, not shared) is assigned to both P1 and P2, which run at the same time in wave 1. | `preflight.json:84-87` | `ACCOUNT_CONFLICT` | Add a separate clerk account with its own reset command and login probe, and give each package its own account |
| 4 | The record has no `plan` binding (`digest` and `base`). | Missing from `preflight.json` | `SCHEMA` / `PREFLIGHT_STALE` | Add `plan.digest` from the new plan check and `base: 3f9c2e1` |
| 5 | The plan has no `execution.unattended`, and no package has `needs`. P1 and P2 run `npm test` commands but declare no `environment` need. | `plan.json:15-22`, packages | `NEEDS_UNDECLARED`; the gate would give `PREFLIGHT_REQUIRED` | Add `unattended: true` and `needs` to each package, including access, account and environment needs |
| 6 | No entry has `covers`. | All entries | `PREREQUISITE_UNCOVERED` | Add `covers` to each access, account and environment entry for the needs it proves |

My own judgment, which the checker cannot catch:
- The U3 probe E4 is `probe:login -- clerk-b auditor`. It mentions a `clerk-b` account the record never declares, and it is unclear that it proves the auditor role. Either declare clerk-b (this would also fix problem 3), or give the auditor its own probe.
- D2 (sort order when dates tie) is a reversible default. It will be listed as queued for the human to confirm when the run reaches the merge boundary.
- The record does not say whether the lead may raise the retry or rework limits during the run. Add that as a decision, or the run stops for a question nobody is awake to answer.
- E7 shows that a test escalation was delivered once, six days ago. Re-send one before 22:00 to confirm the push channel still reaches the owner.

These parts already hold up: baseline `npm test` (E6, which is the profile's only check, V1) passed at the base. I-2 is `PARTLY-READY` and marked reversible. Both decisions were made by a human. Human steps are limited to `before` and `end`. The record names secrets but holds no values.

```text
Gate:        Not run: the run has not started
Verified:    None
Unverified:  REQ-12-AC1, REQ-13-AC1, P3-AC1
Open:        problems 1-6 above, plus the clerk-b/U3 probe and the missing decision on raising limits
Merge:       human approval required
```
